title: Read and build URLs with URLSearchParams
why_it_matters: Filters and pagination are easier to share when they live in the URL.
explanation: URLSearchParams parses the query string for you. get reads a value, set changes it, and toString builds the new text with proper escaping. It's much safer than slicing strings by hand.
try_it: Build a link with a search term that contains a space and an ampersand.
